info.name: Telecom Service & Network Management System
info.description: Folder '00 - End-to-End Demo Flow' runs the mandatory scenario in order (use the Collection Runner); each request stores the ids the next one needs. The other folders contain every endpoint.

body.raw:

request.description: Super Admin only: create staff accounts or customer logins linked to a customer profile.
Note: use the account's email address as the 'username' field.
Use assignment_status=completed for completed jobs, =assigned for pending jobs.
Equipment with no recent heartbeat (likely down).
Customers see notifications addressed to their customer profile; staff see ones addressed to them.
Staff-only view of generated notifications (optionally for one customer). Used for demo verification.

Runs the scheduled maintenance jobs once: auto-renew/expire subscriptions, plan-expiry and
maintenance notifications, and SLA-breach flagging. In production trigger these from cron/Celery beat.

Tickets that are unresolved and past their SLA deadline.
Pass notify=true to also flag them as breached and raise SLA-breach notifications.
Upgrade or downgrade is determined automatically by comparing plan prices.
Customers can raise tickets for themselves; staff can raise them on behalf of any customer.

Records (or accumulates onto) a day's usage for a subscription.
Crossing 80% / 100% of any quota raises a one-off usage-threshold notification.
